author: Wahiz
body:
Ok, so I have heard about the team speak rule stating that if your banned in game your banned on ts, but I have heard  that the rule has been dropped. But I find it pointless to ban someone on ts if they are in game.

So I was wondering if I may be un banned on Team Speak because I don't really see the point for that rule.

~Dawson
